entities.summary: Large-scale Anatolian dance productions combining mass choreography, costume, music and mythic storytelling.
entities.description: Fire of Anatolia and Troy are focused evening spectacles built around very large dance ensembles, traditional and contemporary movement, music, costume and mythic/historical imagery. Treat this as a headline performance rather than a full-day attraction, and verify the exact production, date and venue before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: One of Europe’s strongest focused cultural spectacles: unusually large ensemble movement and visual storytelling deliver a major-trip evening with little language friction.
